name: Leonardo Baptista de Jesus
text: MF Project Solutions provided an excellent house surveying and snagging service for my second-hand home. They responded quickly to my WhatsApp enquiry, arrived on time for the inspection, and delivered a clear, comprehensive report within just a few days. Their professionalism, efficiency, and attention to detail made the process seamless—I highly recommend them!
